title: Printed Page Numbers by PDF Page Number
description: Maps each pdf_page_number to its corresponding printed_page_number(s) for each issue. Derived from human-reviewed anchor points via the trains_magazine_extractor page-number inference pipeline.

issues.description: Map from issue date (YYYY-MM) to page mapping data.

pdf_page_number_to_printed_page_numbers.description: Maps a pdf_page_number (1-based index into the PDF file, as a numeric string key) to one or more printed_page_numbers. Single-element lists for normal pages; multi-element for gatefold pages that span multiple printed pages. Chrome and cover pages without a printed_page_number are omitted. printed_page_numbers are strings: purely numeric ("42") or lettered for insert sections ("30b", "30c").
